items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Nick. Ployz (https://ployz.dev) gives you Railway's UX on Linux servers you rent - start with a single server and grow from there. The code is at https://github.com/getployz/ployz.
I've always wanted a self-hosting solution that can deliver a top-tier experience rivalling or beating what cloud platforms offer. By being opinionated, I believe it delivers on this:
- A single flat mesh (any service can contact any other service, simply)
- Start with a single server, scale from there

items.title: Show HN: whytime: time(1) that tells you where the wall-clock time went
items.contentSnippet:
time says a command took 3.8 seconds... whytime tells you where those seconds went:
  $ sudo whytime -- sh -c 'sleep 0.5; dd … oflag=dsync; curl -s -o /dev/null https://speed.cloudflare.com/…'
  wall 3.83s
    47%  blocked on network: speed.cloudflare.com:443 (1 connection)
    34%  fsync on ~/.cache
    13%  timer sleep (sleep)
     4%  on-CPU (curl)
     2%  other

It can also draw a flamegraph.
Uses eBPF (Linux 5.18+)
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50201687
Points: 1
